notes: Addresses confirmed by reading TunerPro RT's Table Properties dialog (Address/Rows/Columns/Conversion tabs) and cross-checking raw bytes in the stock .bin against the values TunerPro displayed. Only tables verified this way belong in this file — do not add guessed offsets here.

tables.name: TPS vs RPM Load - หลัก
tables.verified: byte-exact match against TunerPro screenshot values (row RPM=1000 and RPM=1200, cols TPS 0.0-6.0) and TunerPro's General/Rows/Columns/Conversion tabs for XDF ID 9203

tables.name: TPS vs RPM Fast-Idle - เดินเบา
tables.verified: TunerPro's General/Rows/Columns/Conversion tabs for XDF ID 18043 gave address/size/equation; raw bytes at this address decode to a smooth 0-16 range matching the table's declared Use High Range, and the table's 35x29x2=2030-byte footprint ends at exactly 0x3A078 with zero gap, i.e. immediately where the TPS vs RPM Load table begins — no cell-value screenshot was available to cross-check individual numbers the way the Load table was

tables.name: Ingnition :ไฟ-1
tables.verified: byte-exact match against TunerPro screenshot values (row RPM=1000 and RPM=1200, cols 0-11 all read 14.60,14.60,11.49,11.49,...) and TunerPro's General/Rows/Columns/Conversion tabs for XDF ID 9898; does not overlap the Fast-Idle or Load table byte ranges

tables.name: Ingnition :ไฟ-2
tables.verified: TunerPro's General/Rows/Columns/Conversion tabs for XDF ID 22064 gave address/size/equation; the table's 35x29x1=1015-byte footprint ends at exactly 0x3BA36 with zero gap, i.e. immediately where the Ingnition :ไฟ-1 table begins, same back-to-back pattern as Fast-Idle/Load; raw bytes here currently equal ไฟ-1's values byte-for-byte (both timing tables happen to hold the same tune in this .bin) — no distinct cell-value screenshot for ไฟ-2 itself was available. This table's X/Y Axis DA Link is unset ("No Link") in TunerPro, unlike the other three tables

tables.name: TPS vs RPM Secondary - ชดเชย
tables.verified: TunerPro's General/Rows/Columns/Conversion/DA Assoc tabs for XDF ID 5612 confirm address, 35x29, 16-bit, X/1000, No Link; stock-file raw values at this address decode to a smooth ~0.9-1.6 range matching its declared 0-7 display range. This table's 35x29x2=2030-byte span (0x3C82A-0x3D017) is exactly the block that very first stock-vs-tuned byte diff (done before any table address was known) found entirely zeroed out in the tuned .bin files — this table being disabled/zeroed is what that mystery block was

tables.name: TPS
tables.verified: byte-exact match: all 29 raw values at 0x3B59C decode via X*0.0976 to 0.0, 0.39, 0.59, 0.98, 1.46, 1.95, 3.03, 4.00, 4.98, 5.95, 7.03, 8.00, 9.96, 12.01, 13.96, 16.01, 17.96, 20.01, 24.99, 29.96, 34.94, 40.02, 44.99, 49.97, 54.95, 59.93, 65.00, 70.96, 72.52 — matching the 29 TPS axis values shown in TunerPro's own "TPS" table screenshot (0.0 to 72.5) within rounding tolerance. This is the shared TPS breakpoint scale that TPS vs RPM Load/Fast-Idle/Secondary and Ingnition :ไฟ-1 all link their X axis to (their own 'Pure Internal Axis Label Parameters' shown in the Rows/Columns tabs, address 0x3B59C at 1-byte/step -4, is a separate legacy representation TunerPro keeps but doesn't appear to be what's actually used when Label Source is 'Linked, Scale')

tables.name: RPM
tables.verified: byte-exact match: all 35 raw values at 0x3B5D6 read 1000,1200,1400,1500,1600,1700,1800,2000,2250,2500,3000,3500,3750,4000,4250,4500,4750,5000,5250,5500,5750,6000,6250,6500,6750,7000,7250,7500,7750,8000,8250,8500,9000,9500,9850 — matching the RPM row headers shown in TunerPro's table screenshots exactly (once a transcription slip of an extra '2750' in the earlier chat notes was corrected against the actual bytes). This is the shared RPM breakpoint scale that TPS vs RPM Load/Fast-Idle/Secondary and Ingnition :ไฟ-1/ไฟ-2 all link their Y axis to; TunerPro's General/Rows/Columns/Conversion/DA Assoc tabs for XDF ID 23496 confirm address, 35x1, 16-bit, identity equation, No Link

tables.name: ล็อคโหมดใส่ทุกกล่อง
tables.verified: byte-exact match: the 4 raw bytes at 0x3C0D9 read 1,1,0,1 in the stock .bin, matching TunerPro's floating dashboard widget for this parameter exactly; TunerPro's General/Rows/Columns/Conversion/DA Assoc tabs for XDF ID 20436 confirm 1x4, 8-bit, identity equation, No Link. This is also the exact 4-byte block the very first stock-vs-tuned diff (done before any address was known) found changing from 01 01 00 01 to 00 00 00 00 in tuned files — i.e. this flag being cleared to all-zero is a real, intentional change in the tune, not noise
